name: Phoenix West II (The Oasis formerly Phoenix West II)

about.description: The Oasis formerly Phoenix West II is a luxury Orange Beach property offering beachfront condos with all the benefits of a beachfront resort combined with the comforts of home. Features well-appointed 3 and 4-bedroom units that can sleep up to 14 guests. Units range from approximately 1,950 to 2,550 square feet. Property underwent renovations in summer 2024 including new outdoor bar & grill, adult pool, enhanced splash pad, pickleball court, half-court basketball, and new pavilion center.
about.elevator_pitch: Luxury Orange Beach beachfront resort with spacious 3-4 bedroom condos, panoramic Gulf views, and resort-style amenities including pools, lazy river, and direct beach access.
